recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up work is needed for FHIR-14464 unless a separate issue asks to change subtitle metadata semantics beyond the element addition audited here.
issue_request: FHIR-14464 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for STU3 asking to add a 0..1 subtitle metadata element to the knowledge resources ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, Library, Measure, and EventDefinition.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in SVN revision 13290, preserved as Git commit a1cc4ed53f2d5cbc4633b5869d6c58d983fc81ef, whose subject cites GF#14464 and states that it added a subtitle to all knowledge resources.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists the five target resources, and current StructureDefinition XML source for each target resource contains a subtitle element immediately after title. Jira and community searches found no later conflicting final decision; broader Zulip and Confluence searches returned only a commit bot mention or unrelated pages.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already satisfies the Jira resolution.
